purpose: Determine whether the V19DN Bullet soft-spectrum failure is background dominated or heterogeneous across observation, detector and epoch before fitting another plasma model or constructing a source invariant.

decision.background_dominated: Freeze an observation-resolved blank-sky and soft-calibration likelihood before any regional temperature production.
decision.heterogeneous: Freeze a joint likelihood retaining detector and observation/epoch controls with no per-observation gravity parameter.
decision.source_dominated_and_stable: Test spatially resolved plasma variation with unmerged responses; do not add a global component to the integrated spectrum.
decision.no_authorization: V19DO is diagnostic and cannot authorize a plasma model, full regional run, I4, I5, lensing or action.

claim_boundary: Counts and scaling metadata are already-opened source-only products; no lensing or halo outcome enters the audit.
The energy bands and interpretation thresholds are frozen before per-observation results are opened.
Observation, detector and epoch are instrumental coordinates, not galaxy/cluster gravity labels.
No extra plasma component, calibration systematic, source invariant or gravity parameter is admitted.
